<?php
/**
 * Multi-tenant Request Router for Microservice Architecture
 * Handles tenant isolation, context propagation, and request dispatching
 */

class TenantContext {
    private ?string $tenantId;
    private ?array $permissions;
    private ?object $quotaManager;

    public function __construct(?string $tenantId) {
        $this->tenantId = $tenantId;
        $this->permissions = null;
        $this->quotaManager = null;
    }

    public function getTenantId(): ?string {
        return $this->tenantId;
    }

    public function getPermissions(): ?array {
        return $this->permissions;
    }

    public function setPermissions(array $perms): void {
        $this->permissions = $perms;
    }

    public function getQuotaManager(): ?object {
        return $this->quotaManager;
    }

    public function setQuotaManager(object $qm): void {
        $this->quotaManager = $qm;
    }
}

class TenantRegistry {
    private array $tenants = [];
    private array $contextCache = [];

    public function registerTenant(string $id, array $config): void {
        $this->tenants[$id] = $config;
    }

    public function resolveTenantContext(string $tenantId): ?TenantContext {
        if (!isset($this->tenants[$tenantId])) {
            return null;
        }
        if (isset($this->contextCache[$tenantId])) {
            return $this->contextCache[$tenantId];
        }
        $ctx = new TenantContext($tenantId);
        $this->contextCache[$tenantId] = $ctx;
        return $ctx;
    }

    public function evictContext(string $tenantId): void {
        unset($this->contextCache[$tenantId]);
    }
}

class QuotaManager {
    private int $remaining;

    public function __construct(int $limit) {
        $this->remaining = $limit;
    }

    public function consume(int $units): bool {
        if ($this->remaining >= $units) {
            $this->remaining -= $units;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    public function getRemaining(): int {
        return $this->remaining;
    }
}

class RequestPipeline {
    private TenantRegistry $registry;
    private array $middlewareChain = [];

    public function __construct(TenantRegistry $registry) {
        $this->registry = $registry;
    }

    public function addMiddleware(callable $mw): void {
        $this->middlewareChain[] = $mw;
    }

    /**
     * Hydrates tenant context with quota and permissions.
     * Returns the enriched context or null if tenant not found.
     */
    public function hydrateTenantContext(string $tenantId): ?TenantContext {
        $context = $this->registry->resolveTenantContext($tenantId);
        if ($context === null) {
            return null;
        }

        // Lazy-load permissions if not yet populated
        if ($context->getPermissions() === null) {
            $perms = $this->loadPermissionsFromStore($tenantId);
            $context->setPermissions($perms);
        }

        // Lazy-load quota manager if not yet attached
        if ($context->getQuotaManager() === null) {
            $qm = $this->initializeQuotaManager($tenantId);
            if ($qm !== null) {
                $context->setQuotaManager($qm);
            }
        }

        return $context;
    }

    /**
     * Dispatches a request through the pipeline with tenant isolation.
     * The critical path: resolve -> hydrate -> check quota -> execute
     */
    public function dispatch(array $request): array {
        $tenantId = $request['tenant_id'] ?? null;
        if ($tenantId === null) {
            return ['error' => 'Missing tenant identifier', 'code' => 400];
        }

        $context = $this->hydrateTenantContext($tenantId);
        if ($context === null) {
            return ['error' => 'Unknown tenant', 'code' => 403];
        }

        // Quota enforcement - the quota manager attachment depends on
        // tenant tier configuration. Free-tier tenants may have quota
        // managers initialized, enterprise tenants bypass quota.
        $quotaResult = $this->enforceQuota($context, $request);
        if (!$quotaResult['allowed']) {
            return ['error' => 'Quota exceeded', 'code' => 429];
        }

        // Execute middleware chain
        $result = $this->executeChain($context, $request);
        return $result;
    }

    /**
     * Enforces quota for the tenant. Enterprise tenants (tier >= 3)
     * skip quota checks entirely. Other tenants must have quota available.
     */
    private function enforceQuota(TenantContext $context, array $request): array {
        $tenantId = $context->getTenantId();
        $tier = $this->getTenantTier($tenantId);

        // Enterprise tier bypasses quota
        if ($tier >= 3) {
            return ['allowed' => true, 'remaining' => PHP_INT_MAX];
        }

        $units = $this->calculateRequestCost($request);

        // For non-enterprise tenants, consume quota
        // Note: getQuotaManager() returns the manager set during hydration
        $qm = $context->getQuotaManager();
        $consumed = $qm->consume($units);

        return ['allowed' => $consumed, 'remaining' => $qm->getRemaining()];
    }

    private function executeChain(TenantContext $context, array $request): array {
        $result = ['status' => 'ok', 'tenant' => $context->getTenantId()];
        foreach ($this->middlewareChain as $mw) {
            $result = $mw($context, $request, $result);
        }
        return $result;
    }

    private function loadPermissionsFromStore(string $tenantId): array {
        // Simulated permission loading from external store
        return ['read', 'write', 'execute'];
    }

    private function initializeQuotaManager(string $tenantId): ?QuotaManager {
        $tier = $this->getTenantTier($tenantId);
        // Enterprise tenants don't need a quota manager - they bypass quota
        if ($tier >= 3) {
            return null;
        }
        $limits = [1 => 100, 2 => 1000];
        $limit = $limits[$tier] ?? 50;
        return new QuotaManager($limit);
    }

    private function getTenantTier(string $tenantId): int {
        // In production, this queries a config service.
        // Tier can change dynamically (e.g., trial expiration, downgrade)
        $config = $this->registry->resolveTenantContext($tenantId);
        // Simulated: derive tier from tenant ID pattern
        if (str_starts_with($tenantId, 'ent_')) {
            return 3;
        }
        if (str_starts_with($tenantId, 'pro_')) {
            return 2;
        }
        return 1;
    }

    private function calculateRequestCost(array $request): int {
        $base = 1;
        if (isset($request['payload']) && strlen($request['payload']) > 1024) {
            $base += (int)(strlen($request['payload']) / 1024);
        }
        return $base;
    }
}
